title: KD distillation baseline rerun with corrected loss normalization
notes: Reshaping (B*T, V) before F.kl_div(reduction='batchmean') correctly divides by B*T, matching CE per-token scale.
alpha=0 acts as built-in regression test against cycle 213 CE-only baseline (46.424).
If best alpha turns out to be 0.0, verdict should be INCONCLUSIVE regardless of PPL since KD adds nothing.
Keep alpha=0 in the sweep unless wall time is actually tight — it's the most valuable wiring diagnostic.
